notes: Grundl Freight Shield, 4x4: a riveted steel frame with corrugated side panels and amber stencil bands, round a blue shield disc held in a cage of heavy bars; four fuel-cell lamps along the bottom (the cells the crew restock) light blue one by one on the 4-frame loop and a chain hangs slack from each top corner. Off: a dull disc and dark cells. Damaged: a cage bar bent, a chain snapped, a cell dark, the disc stuttering. Disabled: the disc dead, the cage twisted, a plate sprung.
